## Problem

Identify fraudulent credit card transactions from European cardholders (September 2013), where fraud is a tiny fraction of all transactions.

## Approach

Handling extreme class imbalance and choosing metrics suited to the problem, comparing classification models.

## Technologies

[Python]{.tag} [scikit-learn]{.tag} [Imbalanced classification]{.tag}
